description: Check whether the next word correctly follows the previous word in shiritori: it must start with the previous word's last kana, it loses if it ends in ん or was already used. Also tells whether each word is in the dictionary and what the next word must start with.

loose_dakuten.description: House rule: allow ば→は/ぱ style dakuten variants.

previous.description: The previous word (kana is safest; kanji is looked up in the dictionary).

used.description: Words already used in this game.

name: check_move
title: Check a shiritori move
